name: Voicegram Public API
description:
The Voicegram public API lets you integrate Voicegram with Zapier, Make,
n8n, or any custom system. All requests authenticate via a Personal Access
Token (PAT) sent in the `Authorization: Bearer vg_pat_<...>` header.

## Authentication

Create a PAT in the Voicegram dashboard at `/dashboard/integrations/api-tokens`.
Tokens are bound to a single account and inherit that account's permissions.
The token format is `vg_pat_<64-hex>`; only the prefix is stored in plaintext
server-side, so the token is unrecoverable from the dashboard after creation.

## Plan gating

All endpoints except `GET /api/v1/me` require a paid plan (Starter or above).
PATs for free-plan accounts authenticate successfully against `/me` so
integrations can display a meaningful upgrade prompt, but every other
endpoint returns `403 plan_required`.

## Rate limiting

Each endpoint is rate limited per account. On `429 rate_limited`,
back off and retry.

## Webhook delivery semantics

Webhook URLs registered via `POST /api/v1/webhook-subscriptions` must be
terminal receivers: any `3xx` response is treated as a delivery failure
recorded as `redirect_blocked: <status>`. Configure your endpoint to
respond directly with `2xx`, `4xx`, or `5xx`. See
https://voicegram.io/docs/integrations/webhooks for details.

Outbound deliveries POST a JSON body signed with an HMAC in the
`X-Voicegram-Signature` header (`t=<unix-seconds>,v1=<hex-hmac>`),
and each attempt carries a unique `X-Voicegram-Delivery-Id` header
(UUID, fresh per attempt) for support correlation. Failed deliveries
are retried with backoff over several hours before auto-disable.
